title: Color members should be double in gdextension_api.json
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.4.0 and Godot 4.4.1 release

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

Hey folks,

I enjoy working with Godot and am trying to create a GDExtension. During testing, I found out, that in the gdextension_api.json, the members of `Color` are marked as floats:
```JSON
{
	"name": "Color",
	"members": [
		{
			"member": "r",
			"offset": 0,
			"meta": "float"
		},
		{
			"member": "g",
			"offset": 4,
			"meta": "float"
		},
		{
			"member": "b",
			"offset": 8,
			"meta": "float"
		},
		{
			"member": "a",
			"offset": 12,
			"meta": "float"
		}
	]
}
```

However this leads to problems, as internally, Godot is expecting `doubles`. This leads to overflowing of values, e.g. not being able to create a color with r,g,b, because all values are interpreted as `0´ or getting  numbers at `0` when getting values from a `Color` object

### Steps to reproduce

You can use the project, I attached below, it can also be found here: [Godot Color bug](https://github.com/niklas2902/godot-color-bug)

To build (only windows):
- run sconsscons platform=windows
- Start godot with console in edit mode
- In the console, you should see:
```shell
ERROR: Error opening file 'D:/py4godot-examples/heightmap/icon.svg'.
   at: (core/io/image_loader.cpp:89)
Editing project: D:/color_extension/color-example
Godot Engine v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.3.260 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: AMD - AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics

ERROR: Color example
   at: initialize_color_extension (color_extension.c:115)
ERROR: red_val: -0.000000
   at: initialize_color_extension (color_extension.c:122) 
```
❌

the value `red_val` should actually be `0.8`

If you need further steps for being able to reproduce or need other platforms, feel free to ask

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[color_extension.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19606307/color_extension.zip)
